cards.title: Apply valid discount code as authenticated user
cards.description: Verify that an authenticated user can apply a valid discount code at checkout and that the order total is reduced by the percentage specified in the discount record.
cards.preconditions: User is logged in with a valid session; a valid discount code exists with a defined percentage; cart contains at least one item totaling more than $10.00.

cards.title: Verify order total reduction matches discount percentage exactly
cards.description: Verify that applying a valid discount code (SAVE10, 10%) reduces the order subtotal by exactly that percentage.
cards.preconditions: User is authenticated; discount code SAVE10 (10%) exists; cart subtotal is $55.00 and exceeds $10.00.

cards.title: Display applied discount code and percentage on checkout summary
cards.description: Verify that after successfully applying a discount code, the checkout summary displays both the discount code and its percentage before the user confirms the order.
cards.preconditions: User is authenticated; a valid discount code has been applied to an eligible order.

cards.title: Prevent duplicate application of the same discount code on one order
cards.description: Verify that attempting to apply the same discount code a second time to the same order is rejected, ensuring a discount code is applied only once per order.
cards.preconditions: User is authenticated; a discount code has already been successfully applied to the current order.

cards.title: Prevent checkout when cart contains zero items
cards.description: Verify that the system prevents checkout when the cart is empty, per the cart limits requirement: the checkout link and a direct visit to /checkout both return the user to the cart with an error.
cards.preconditions: User has an active cart with zero items.

cards.title: Lock account after 5 consecutive failed login attempts
cards.description: Verify that five consecutive failed logins for a registered account lock it, and that the 5th failed attempt tells the user the account is locked (while attempts 1-4 only say the credentials are invalid). This test needs its OWN browser session (it logs in through the login page); it must not use the shared pre-authenticated session.
cards.preconditions: Account lockout@example.com exists with no prior failed attempts; the user is logged out.

setup_manifest.note: dedicated account: its lockout state must not affect other tests

cards.title: Locked account refuses the correct password
cards.description: Verify that once an account is locked after 5 failed attempts, logging in with the CORRECT password is still refused with the account-locked message, because the lockout persists for at least 30 minutes. This test needs its OWN browser session (it logs in through the login page); it must not use the shared pre-authenticated session.
cards.preconditions: Account lockout@example.com exists; five failed logins have just been made for it.

setup_manifest.note: dedicated account: its lockout state must not affect other tests

cards.title: Failed login counter resets after a successful login
cards.description: Verify that 4 failed attempts, then a successful login, then logging out and 4 more failed attempts does NOT lock the account (the 4 new failures still show only the invalid-credentials error), because the failed-attempt count resets to zero after a successful login. This test needs its OWN browser session (it logs in through the login page); it must not use the shared pre-authenticated session.
cards.preconditions: Account lockout@example.com exists with no prior failed attempts.

setup_manifest.note: dedicated account: its lockout state must not affect other tests

cards.title: Idle session expires after 30 minutes and the user is told why
cards.description: Verify that a logged-in user whose session has been idle past the 30-minute timeout is sent to the login page and shown a message that the session expired due to inactivity. Use the fixture's expireSession() helper to age the session instead of waiting 30 minutes. This test needs its OWN browser session (it logs in through the login page); it must not use the shared pre-authenticated session.
cards.preconditions: User test@example.com is logged in through the login page in this test's own session.

cards.title: Reject a new password that reuses a previous password
cards.description: Verify that a user who has changed their password twice (to two different long passwords, e.g. 'first-new-password-1' then 'second-new-password-2') is refused when trying to change back to the first one, with an error that the new password must differ from the previous 5. This test needs its OWN browser session (it logs in through the login page); it must not use the shared pre-authenticated session.
cards.preconditions: User pwchange@example.com exists (current password password123, password must be at least 12 characters) and is logged in through the login page.

setup_manifest.note: dedicated account: its password is changed by the test

cards.title: Logged-out session cannot reach authenticated pages
cards.description: Verify that after logging out, navigating directly to the cart page redirects to the login page instead of showing the cart. This test needs its OWN browser session (it logs in through the login page); it must not use the shared pre-authenticated session.
cards.preconditions: User test@example.com is logged in through the login page, then logs out.

cards.title: Fewer than 5 failed attempts do not lock the account
cards.description: Verify that 4 failed login attempts followed by the correct password logs the user in normally to the cart page: the lockout only triggers at 5 consecutive failures. This test needs its OWN browser session (it logs in through the login page); it must not use the shared pre-authenticated session.
cards.preconditions: Account lockout@example.com exists with no prior failed attempts.

setup_manifest.note: dedicated account: its lockout state must not affect other tests

cards.title: Reject a quantity above 99 for a single SKU and leave the cart unchanged
cards.description: Verify that setting the Widget quantity to 100 and updating the cart is rejected with a quantity-limit error (alert), and that the cart is unchanged (another line changed in the same update is not applied).
cards.preconditions: User is logged in with the default cart (1 Widget, 1 Gadget).

cards.title: Accept exactly 99 units of a single SKU
cards.description: Verify the boundary: setting the Widget quantity to 99 and updating the cart is accepted (no error alert) and the Widget quantity input then shows 99.
cards.preconditions: User is logged in with the default cart (1 Widget, 1 Gadget).

cards.title: REGRESSION BUG-1002: discount refused on an order below $10
cards.description: Verify that with a cart totalling $5.00 (1 Sticker only; Widget and Gadget at 0) applying discount code SAVE10 is refused with an error alert saying discount codes cannot be applied to orders under $10.00, and no discount line appears. Regression of a defect where codes were accepted below the minimum.
cards.preconditions: User is logged in; cart contains only 1 Sticker ($5.00).

cards.title: REGRESSION BUG-1001: checkout page shows the discounted total
cards.description: Verify that after applying SAVE20 on the default $50.00 cart and proceeding to checkout, the checkout page shows the discounted total ($40.00) and the discount line, not the full price. Regression of a defect where the checkout page showed a stale pre-discount total.
cards.preconditions: User is logged in with the default cart (1 Widget $30, 1 Gadget $20); no discount applied yet.
